page_title: Wren AI: Open-Source GenBI Data Agent for Teams & AI Agents

summary.name: Wren AI
summary.one_liner: Wren AI is an open-source GenBI agent that lets teams and AI agents (via MCP) ask questions of their data in plain language and get answers built on a governed business context layer.
use_cases: ask business questions in plain English and get dashboards
give AI agents like Claude or ChatGPT governed access to company data
standardize metric definitions across a data team
query Snowflake, BigQuery or PostgreSQL without ETL
get answers with the SQL shown for auditability
deliver data answers in Slack or Microsoft Teams
summary.what_it_does: Wren AI connects to data warehouses and databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, and others, without requiring ETL or data migration. An onboarding agent drafts a context layer of metrics, relationships and definitions, which a data team reviews and approves. Users ask questions in plain English through Wren, Slack or Teams, and AI agents can query the same data over MCP. Each answer is said to show its reasoning and the SQL it ran, and respects row and column access rules. The page says users can drill into and filter the dashboards Wren builds.
notable: Open source, with 18,003 GitHub stars listed on the page
Model Context Protocol (MCP) access so Claude, ChatGPT and custom agents can query the same governed context
Onboarding agent drafts the business context layer for data team review
Deployment options: Wren AI Cloud, your VPC, or fully on-prem
caveats: Free 7-day trial is for Wren AI Cloud; other paid tiers are not described on the page
Connector list beyond the named databases (20+ more) is not enumerated on the page
